title: Diversity and evolution of amphibian pupil shapes (data set: Amphibian pupil data, 1293 records, CSV 366,853 bytes, with ReadMe and references files)
note: Full text read (control-room oa job run 1), bioRxiv preprint posted 16 August 2021 (the text says so); the per-species pupil data set itself was not in the text read, so species records come only from the text

title: Eye size and investment in frogs and toads correlate with adult habitat, activity pattern and breeding ecology (Dryad dataset: Thomas_species_traits.csv, 220 species with activity pattern and habitat)
note: Full text read (control-room oa job run 1): the article on PubMed Central (published version), not the Dryad data set named in the title and DOI. The data set's per-species activity patterns (Thomas_species_traits.csv) were not in the text read and are still unread; the article's only BRIEF-trait value is a cited group statement (Anura mostly nocturnal). Eye and cornea diameters are not BRIEF traits and were not logged.

title: Feeding behavior and visual field differences in loggerhead and leatherback sea turtles may explain differences in longline fisheries interactions
note: Full text read (control-room oa job run 1), published version. The visual fields are given as areas at 20 cm (3550 cm2 leatherback; 11 278 cm2 for the loggerhead's two ellipses) and as a 60-degree loggerhead overlap; no horizontal or vertical field angle in degrees is stated in the text, so fov_h_deg for Dermochelys stays open.
